# QYL0401: GenAI or MCP span missing required attributes

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `GenAI` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0401GenAiMissingRequiredAttributesAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

GenAI and MCP spans must include the unconditional required attributes for their exact registry-defined discriminator, span kind, and provider refinement. Conditional and recommended attributes are not treated as universally required.
